lines.text: Okay, sports moms. Three kids, six teams, and one very tired brain. Let's fix that. This is SIDLNE.
Overview shows you what's up next. Tap Take me there for directions, or Game Day mix to get the car hyped. You're welcome, coach.
Calendar puts every kid on one schedule. Week or month, everybody or just one kid. Color coded, because we are organized now.
Teams is where the magic happens. Paste the calendar link from TeamSnap, SportsEngine, LeagueApps, or GameChanger, and every game loads itself.
And when the coach moves practice at nine p.m.? Your phone tells you. Not the group text. Not the other moms. You.
Add event for the one offs. Picture day, the ortho, the team party nobody told you about.
Tournament weekend? Tap Add tournament, punch in every game at once, and you're done before your coffee gets cold.
Rides. Somebody has to drive. Tap I'll drive, and everybody knows it's handled.
Sharing with other families? Start a carpool, invite the parents, even import your old Google Sheet. Then hit Auto assign. Fair and square. Nobody gets stuck with every Saturday.
Running late? Type at Jen, running five minutes late, in the carpool chat, and her phone buzzes. Instantly. No more ten texts.
Family chat keeps the house in the loop. And under Family, invite your partner, grandma, the nanny. Whoever's on the roster.
SIDLNE. Every sport, one place. Set it up once, and your husband will never ask you for the schedule again. Or their schedule. Ever. You're welcome.
